description: Provision a Google Cloud Alloydb AlloyDBUser via Config Connector. Fields mirror the alloydb.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 AlloyDBUser spec.

clusterRef.description: Immutable. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed AlloyDBCluster resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/clusters/{{clusterID}}".

name.description: The name of an AlloyDBCluster resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of an AlloyDBCluster resource.

databaseRoles.description: List of database roles this database user has.

password.description: Password for this database user. Set exactly one of `value` (a literal) or `valueFrom` (a reference to a Secret key).

value.description: Value of the field. Cannot be used if 'valueFrom' is specified.

valueFrom.description: Source for the field's value. Cannot be used if 'value' is specified.

secretKeyRef.description: Reference to a value with the given key in the given Secret in the resource's namespace.

key.description: Key that identifies the value to be extracted.

name.description: Name of the Secret to extract a value from.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The userId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

userType.description: Immutable. The type of this user. Possible values: ["ALLOYDB_BUILT_IN", "ALLOYDB_IAM_USER"].

title: GCP Alloydb AlloyDBUser
